metadata.description: Agent skills that turn novels into playable games—from full-book analysis and staged design specs to local-tool builds and blind-playtest QA. 把小说做成可玩游戏的 Agent 技能包：通读拆书、玩法与美术策划、用本机工具构建与新玩家盲玩验收。

plugins.name: novel-to-game
plugins.description: Five agent skills that turn a novel into a playable game: full-book analysis, gameplay and art specs, local-tool builds, and new-player blind-playtest QA—supporting RPGs, interactive fiction, interactive films, and WeChat/Douyin/TapTap mini-games. 把小说做成可玩游戏的 5 个 Agent 技能：通读拆书、玩法与美术策划、用本机工具构建与新玩家盲玩验收，支持系统玩法、互动叙事、互动影游及微信/抖音/TapTap 小游戏。
